> 第15章 开始锻骨（第1页）
修炼的岁月，时间一恍而过，江流从炼肉圆满之后，经过每天拼命的修炼，现在每天可以演练十四趟五行拳了。这段时间，江流当真是除了必要花时间的杂务之外。把一切的时间都花在了演练五行拳上面，对比其他的学徒不知道刻苦多少。就连王壮这个修炼狂人，都要甘拜下风。每次跟江流对练，王壮都是被打得爬不起来。可是到第二天，依旧生龙活虎的来跟江流对练。江流也是啧啧称奇。江流每天练完拳，如果不是真忍受不了身上的汗臭味，都想不洗漱就直接休息了。这晚对练完后，江流意念一动，一道深蓝色的光幕出现在江流面前辅助系统:姓名:江流境界:炼体（炼肉）炼药（入门37100）基础拳术（未入门510）五行拳（小成133300）想到前三天每天十一趟，后面两天每天十二趟，这两天每天十四趟。身体已经逐渐达到容纳气血的极限了。一个星期就演练了八十五次五行拳，按照这个进度，十多天就可以大成了。真不容易啊!江流盘坐在地，恢复气血。缓缓地搬运气血，运行到胸骨的时候，突然感觉有了一丝变化，好像其中的一块胸骨的边沿不一样?江流心神一动!这是?难道是开始锻骨?有事不决?问系统辅助系统:姓名:江流境界:炼体（锻骨01206）这真是开始锻骨了!江流不知道别人开始锻骨是从哪块开始的。但是江流知道自己从胸骨开始，应该是跟自己的完美运行五行拳运气法门有关。因为胸骨是保护心脏的外壳，只有心脏供血充足，才会产生足够的气血，去继续提升身体素质。容纳更多的气血，进一步锻造身体。练武就是一步步锻造身体的过程，达到异于常人的境地。当全身心进一步锻造，锻造到极限，就会有股气从其生。这个气跟气血的气是不一样的。气血的气是混合着血而生的，能看见的。这股气是纯净的气，无形无质，只能感应到，看不见摸不着。当能感应到这股气的时候，就说明你已经入品了。我这是算是初入锻骨了?江流脸上充满喜意。细心的感应其中的变化。气血运行到胸骨的时候，确实比其他骨头顺畅许多。境界:炼体（锻骨02206），看来每运行一次气血就可以增进01。以后要花更多的时间去运行气血了，这样双管齐下，早日锻骨完成。翌日一早，江流跟王壮赶到学徒广场，就先打了五趟基础拳术。基础拳术（入门0100）。系统就立马显示，发现可合并拳术是否确定合并？江流脑海里确定是。基础拳术就消失了，五行拳熟练度增加了10。"林海，我出去的这段时间，叫你留意江流的情况，有什么发现没有?"林爷边走边对跟着的林海问道。"林爷没有发现什么异常!只是江流的进度，确实是比其他人快。马师傅还额外奖励了他汤药!"林海回道。"那他的身世调查清楚没有?"林爷接着问道。"已经调查清楚了，就是一个普普通通的，住在城西的平民，父母双亡了。""平时靠着帮客栈酒楼拉客混点温饱。小的时候上过蒙学，才去药铺当学徒的。他家是祖父那一代迁居到这里的，其他没有什么特别。"林海回道。"这样啊!好!你等下把江流给我叫过来，我看看他。"林爷坐下道。"我离开这段时间，堂里有什么事没有?"林爷接着问道。"大事倒是没有，就是福荣街有点不安定。"林海回应道。"发生什么事了?"林爷眉头一皱道。"就是连续几天，抓到有人在我们的赌场出千!""哦?哪个吃了熊心豹子胆的!敢在我们赌场出千?""连续几天?那就是好几次了?人抓起来没有?有没有审出幕后主使是谁?""人还在地牢关着，咬死不开口，还不承认是一伙的!""看来，是有人眼红我捕鹰堂啊!""眼红我捕鹰堂?难道不是外人?""你先不要声张!就先把人关着!不用管他们先!我自有用处!""是!"林海应完就出去了。

The latest chapter of Saint: Suppressing the Thirteen States with One Sword_Chapter 15 Begins to Forge the Bones Page 1_The Sage: Suppressing the Thirteen States with One Sword has a long road ahead_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 15 Begin to Forge Bones (Page 1)
The years of training went by in a flash. After Jiang Liu had perfected the meat-refining process and practiced hard every day, he could now practice the Five Elements Boxing fourteen times a day. During this period of time, Jiang Liu really did not do anything but chores that required time. He spent all his time practicing Five Elements Boxing, and compared to other apprentices, he didn't know how hard he worked. Even Wang Zhuang, a cultivator madman, was willing to be defeated. Every time he sparred with Jiang Liu, Wang Zhuang was beaten until he couldn't get up. But on the second day, he was still lively and vigorous in sparring with Jiang Liu. Jiang Liu was also amazed. After Jiang Liu practiced boxing every day, if he couldn't stand the smell of sweat on his body, he would have just rested without washing. After finishing this night's sparring, Jiang Liu thought, and a dark blue light curtain appeared in front of Jiang Liu. Auxiliary system: Name: Jiang Liu Realm: Body Refining (Meat Refining) Medicine Refining (Introduction 37100) Basic Boxing (510 Not Introduced) Five Elements Boxing (Small Level 133300) I thought of eleven trips a day for the first three days, twelve trips a day for the next two days, and fourteen trips a day for the next two days. The body has gradually reached the limit of holding Qi and blood. I practiced Five Elements Boxing eighty-five times in one week. According to this progress, it will be completed in more than ten days. It's not easy! Jiang Liu sat cross-legged on the ground, recovering his energy and blood. Slowly transporting Qi and blood, when it reaches the sternum, he suddenly feels a change, as if the edge of one of the sternums is different? Jiang Liu's mind is moved! Is this? Is he starting to forge the bones? Is there something undecided? Ask the system auxiliary system: Name: Jiang Liu Realm: Body Training (Bone Forging 01206) This is really the beginning of bone forging! Jiang Liu doesn't know where other people start to forge bones. But Jiang Liu knew that starting from the sternum should be related to his perfect operation of the Five Elements Fist luck method. Because the sternum is the shell that protects the heart, only when the heart supplies sufficient blood can it produce enough qi and blood to continue to improve physical fitness. Accommodate more energy and blood to further forge the body. Martial arts training is the process of forging your body step by step to reach a state that is different from ordinary people. When the whole body and mind are further forged and forged to the limit, energy will emerge from it. This qi is different from the qi of qi and blood. The qi of qi and blood is produced by mixing with blood and can be seen. This Qi is pure Qi, intangible and qualityless. It can only be sensed and cannot be seen or touched. When you can sense this energy, it means you have reached the top level. Is this my first experience in bone forging? Jiang Liu's face was full of joy. Carefully sense the changes. When Qi and blood travel to the sternum, it is indeed much smoother than other bones. Realm: Body training (bone training 02206), it seems that every time you run Qi and blood, you can increase 01. In the future, you will have to spend more time running your Qi and blood. In this way, you can complete the bone strengthening as soon as possible through a two-pronged approach. Early the next morning, Jiang Liu and Wang Zhuang rushed to the apprentice square and practiced basic boxing five times. Basic Boxing (Introduction 0100). The system immediately displays the boxing skills that can be merged. Are you sure you want to merge them? Jiang Liu was certain in his mind. The basic boxing skills disappear, and the proficiency of Five Elements Boxing increases by 10. "Lin Hai, I asked you to pay attention to the situation of the river while I was out. Did you find anything?" Master Lin asked Lin Hai who was following him as he walked. "Master Lin didn't find anything unusual! It's just that Jiang Liu's progress is indeed faster than others. Master Ma also rewarded him with decoction!" Lin Hai replied. "Has the investigation into his life experience been clear?" Mr. Lin then asked. "We have already investigated clearly. He is just an ordinary commoner living in the west of the city. Both his parents are dead." "I usually earn a living by soliciting customers for inns and restaurants. When I was young, I went to elementary school and then worked as an apprentice in a drug store. HeMy grandfather's generation moved here, and there's nothing special about it. Lin Hai replied. "That's it! Okay! Call Jiang Liu over later, and I'll take a look at him." "Master Lin sat down and said. "During my absence, has anything happened in the hall?" Master Lin then asked. "There is nothing major, but Furong Street is a bit uneasy. Lin Hai responded. "What happened?" Mr. Lin frowned and asked. "Just for several days in a row, we caught someone cheating in our casino!" "Oh? Who dares to cheat in our casino?" "How many days in a row? That's several times? Has anyone been arrested? Has the mastermind behind the scenes been found out? Who?" "The people are still locked up in the dungeon, and they are being killed without speaking, and they still don't admit that they are a group!" "It seems that someone is jealous of my Eagle Catching Hall!" "Jealous of my Eagle Catching Hall? Isn't it an outsider?" "Don't make any noise yet! Just lock them up first! Don't worry about them first! I have my own use!" "Yes!" Lin Hai said and went out.
